page.overview:
Who is Sunif Brecanti?

Sunif Brecanti was a male human with light skin. During the Imperial Era, they worked as the broker for a co-op of nine webberies in the Beldoni Valley on Ghorman. In 3 BBY, Brecanti addressed a town hall in Palmo, In the address they stated that all of their clients were considering not opening their hives the following spring due to Galactic Empire's ground inspections, freight penalties, and shipping codes changing without warning. They told their electors at the hall the Empire was killing them and that the electors were letting it happen.

During the meeting, Brecanti had greying hair and wore a maroon suit over a white shirt. He expressed his disappointment to Carro Rylanz and other Ghorman electors for letting the Imperial occupation on Ghorman and was very concerned on his trading business.

Sunif Brecanti was created for the second season of the Disney+ television series Star Wars: Andor, first appearing in the season's fourth episode, "Ever Been to Ghorman?" which was released on Disney+ The character was portrayed by Philippe Spall.
